findings: Learner overview: the lower-sign sound account is not adequately explained for a first reading. It says 豕 may “represent the sound of 豭,” but omits why this would fit: 家 and 豭 have matching readings in Modern Mandarin and the cited Old Chinese reconstruction. Clarify that this makes the sound analysis plausible only if 豭 is the relevant element; the earliest sign’s identity remains disputed. The comparison is already supplied in the component data.
